newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's president to address nation on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's president to address nation on Monday.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual will address the nation on Monday evening, the Algerian state-run television said.
The television announcer told Algerians to expect his speech at about 8 p.m. (1900 GMT) but gave no details.
Algerian political sources said they believed Zeroual might announce a date for a referendum to amend the constitution, likely to be held next month.
